name: google-analytics
description: Google Analytics 4: run reports, realtime, pivot and batch reports, metadata and compatibility checks, and list accounts, properties and data streams (read-only; OAuth or service account)

nodes.title: Run report
nodes.description: A GA4 report: dimensions x metrics over date ranges, with filters, sorting and totals

property_id.description: GA4 property id: 123456789 or properties/123456789 (from list_account_summaries)

metric_filter.description: FilterExpression on metric values (applied after aggregation)

date_ranges.description: Date ranges, e.g. [{"startDate": "28daysAgo", "endDate": "yesterday"}] (YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday or NdaysAgo; up to 4; omit for cohort reports)

offset.description: First row to return (0-based); with rowCount for paging

metric_aggregations.description: Extra total rows: TOTAL, MINIMUM, MAXIMUM, COUNT

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. IDR (default: the property's currency)

keep_empty_rows.description: Keep rows whose metrics are all 0

return_property_quota.description: Include the property's remaining quota tokens

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
